WHY BISON

Our love for bison goes far beyond their unrivaled presence and power. There are many reasons they were once the most prolific plains animal inthe world. And we should be eating them.

LEARN MORE
FIELD HARVEST

The way an animal is raised is important, but the way an animal is harvested is more important. We don't believe "efficiency" has a place at the table in harvesting. Our Zero Stress Field Harvest ensures a life of dignity for the animal while preserving an unsurpassed eating experience.

LEARN MORE
REGENERATIVE RANCHING

Regenerative ranching allows nature to patiently optimize the nutritional density of everything it touches above ground while building a diverse, thriving ecosystem below ground that invests in future generations of life.

LEARN MORE
AS NATURE INTENDED

While Regenerative is powerful, it doesn't fully guard against GMOs or liberal antibiotic usage, for example. As Nature Intended is our oath to raising as they were intended, prior to modern agriculture. If it can't be found in nature, we want nothing to do with it.

LEARN MORE
US2U

If we don't know you well, we can't serve you well. Being directly connected to you allows us the ability to maintain relevance while our birth-to-plate vertical integration affords us the agility to improve or diversify our products and service daily. That's the power of US2U.

LEARN MORE
HIDE2HEART

We believe it's right to honor the sacrifice and waste not a morsel. Additionally, people & pets are more deeply nourished when we consume from Hide2Heart. We're proud to be using 98.76% of the carcass in human food, pet food, bone broths, leather goods, artwork, soaps, lip balms, cooking tallow, and more.
Next stop, 100%.

LEARN MORE
JOIN US!

Join us on TikTok & YouTube for exclusive releases, unboxing and cooking videos!

When you know your rancher, you don’t have to worry about your food. Transparency, trust, and clean eating start here. Every bite tells a story—raised with care, harvested with respect, and delivered to nourish.

SHIPPING POLICY

We ship to USA addresses ONLY.

***Orders (frozen product) placed before 10 am CST will ship same day as long as the selected service allows.

We are shipping experts, who deliver the freshest meat at the best price for the value. Ask anyone who has tasted it. Our goal is to ship our product to you so that it safely arrives with its full nutrition and flavor preserved. Our meats are processed fresh and then custom-cut fresh or flash frozen until they arrive at your door. This method allows us to deliver meats of the highest possible quality.

Our shipping rates are the best in the industry. You can trust your order to be packed with extra care and attention to protect the meat for the trip to your address. Since we process the meat on a weekly basis, you can expect the freshest meat in the industry. Whatever is not shipped fresh, unfrozen, is quick frozen for preservation until it arrives at your intended location.

I. Our Shipping Guarantee

***FRESH product ships on Tuesday or Wednesdays weekly. Call to confirm the date of estimated arrival if you have a particular event that you desire the product for. We aim to please and will do our best to accommodate your needs. Always choose "Next Day delivery" for fresh/never frozen meat products to guarantee the best condition upon delivery.

If you are not completely satisfied with your order and notify us within 24 hrs, we will issue a credit, refund or replacement of the product that you are dissatisfied with (your choice). To assure that your order arrives properly frozen, you will never receive your order on Sunday or Monday.

If you need to have a shipment made on Friday for Saturday arrival, you must call by- 3 pm on Thursday to assure the arrangement. Call 715-458-4300 to set up special needs. We aim to accommodate!

How We Pack Our Meats

All perishable product is packed in insulated coolers with liners. Dry ice and/or gel packs are added to maintain necessary temperatures to protect product as ordered; fresh or frozen until it arrives at your desired destination.

FRESH orders are required to be shipped by NEXT DAY DELIVERY METHOD.

REMINDER: Fresh and frozen product combination orders can't be guaranteed of arrival condition; ie, frozen may start to thaw and/or fresh may start to freeze. Both may be frozen or refrigerated upon arrival.

If you need a price quote before your order is shipped, either call or indicate that on your order in the "comment" section.

We would love to answer any questions you have about bison meat so feel free to contact us at contact@northstarbison.com.

PLEASE NOTE: All orders are first come - first served. We cannot specify a time of day of when your package will deliver but the package should arrive between 8:00 am and 8:00 pm on the scheduled day of delivery.

If shipping to a business please state your hours of operation Monday thru Friday.

If you choose Standard Shipping, please be sure to try to order the week prior because if you order after Monday Noon CST, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, your order will not be scheduled to ship until the next following Monday.

Again, prompt service is a priority along with superior quality product and will attempt to ship orders placed before noon CST, the same day if chosen shipping method will deliver the package before the weekend.

IV. How We Ship Our Meats

Our advanced shipping system only uses shipping methods which are capable of getting your perishable product to you in 3 days or less to ensure that your order arrives frozen.

V. When We Ship

We make every effort to ship your product as soon as possible. However, in order to ensure the freshest product we operate on a "just in time" inventory system. This means that some of our products may be momentarily unavailable and your shipment may be delayed.

Again, prompt service is a top priority along with our superior quality products and will attempt to ship orders placed before noon the same day if the chosen shipping method will deliver the package before the weekend.

VI. Keeping Shipping Costs Low

Due to Northstar Bison's high shipping volumes, we negotiate reduced shipping rates from our shipping service providers and pass these savings on to you.
Please note that your shipping cost per pound will always be lower if you order more product.
VII. Northstar Bison Store Locations:

1) Pickup Location for products Monday thru Friday 8 til 4 pm & Saturdays by Appointment. Please call Mary's cell (715-651-0965) for Saturday pickup to discuss your arrival time.

Bison Bucks FAQ

Bison Bucks Frequently Asked Questions

Q: WHAT ARE BISON BUCKS?

A: Bison Bucks are one way we say THANK YOU! Thank you for partnering with us in the conservation of our planet. Producing products as nature intended means healthier people, healthier animals, and a healthier planet but we couldn't do anything without you. That said, it is our mission to provide you an outstanding experience when it comes to service, honesty, transparency, product quality, and a commitment to ALWAYS doing the right thing. And the Bison Bucks should just be a nice bonus!

Q: HOW CAN I EARN BISON BUCKS?

A: Earning Bison Bucks is easy! You'll earn Bison Bucks whether you're logged into your account or not.

Here are some other ways to earn some bonus Bison Bucks:
(Make sure you're logged into your account in order to complete the following campaigns)
~ Have A Birthday  (Yep, you'll get Bison Bucks to spend as a cheers toward another year of healthy & happy!)
~ Follow Us on Instagram or Facebook 
~ Refer a Friend
~ + More which are shown on your account page!

Q: HOW CAN I REDEEM MY BISON BUCKS?

A: Log in. Then, go into checkout and there will be a slider bar on the first page where you can select the exact amount of Bison Bucks you'd like to redeem. Watch this short Bison Bucks video!

**If you don't have an account, simply create one or activate a previous account. **Note: If the last time you purchased from us was prior to Sept. 1, 2019, your account may not have been activated in our new site database yet. In that case, simply assign a password to your account (can be your the same as your old one!).  

**Please note; While Bison Bucks are earned with subscription orders, Bison Bucks cannot be redeemed on subscriptions. To use your Bison Bucks, place a regular, one-time order.
**Also if you have an unused code from the past, you can paste it into the discount code field to apply it to your order.

Q: DO MY BISON BUCKS EXPIRE?

A: Yes, Bison Bucks do expire. They will expire 24 months (2 years) after you initially earned them. 

Q: I CAN'T SEE MY BISON BUCKS! OR; MY ACCOUNT PAGE ISN'T LOADING CORRECTLY.

A: You're possibly experiencing a browser functionality issue. Try clearing the cache in your browser.
For Google Chrome: https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en
For Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/how-clear-firefox-cache
For Safari: https://clear-my-cache.com/en/apple-mac-os/safari.html

Q: I LOST MY BISON BUCKS COUPON CODE! IS IT GONE FOREVER?!

A: Nope! Your Bison Bucks code has been stored in a safe place for you to still use if you lose it. Simply go to your account page, click on Rewards History button and you'll see any codes you redeemed. Simply copy the code and paste it into the discount code field in the checkout process. :)

Have a question about Bison Bucks you can't find an answer to? Please reach out!
Call 715-458-4300 or email us at contact@northstarbison.com

SHIPPING

Who doesn't want to be this guy?! Having a fist pump moment because his order arrived so awesomely...

Cool part is, so many of our customers actually expereince this. And you can too!

Successful deliveries take a lot of intentionality.

Read on to learn our process and why you can have confidence when ordering with Northstar.

Why shipping food can feel intimidating.

For many people, the scariest part about ordering food online is shipping. Many brands mess this up so it only adds to the level of apprehension... 

Will it stay frozen?!
Will it arrive on time?!
What happens if something goes wrong?!

With humble confidence; we got you. 

 

We invest significant time, energy, and care into making sure your order arrives safely and in excellent condition. From weather monitoring to dry ice calculations to delivery tracking, every step of the process is intentional. 

We want you to know your order is in good hands.

 

How we prepare your order.

 

After cutting and packaging, all products are flash frozen and held around 0°F to preserve freshness and quality. 

Then every Monday morning, before the sun is even up, our shipping team is analyzing weather patterns, transit conditions, and delivery routes across the country to determine: 

what is safe to ship,

where conditions may create delays,

and how much dry ice each shipment will require.  

We intentionally ship orders so they arrive the same week and never sit in transit over a weekend whenever possible. Sometimes this means your order may ship a little later than expected, but we believe protecting product quality is worth the extra care.

How we protect your order.

 

Once your order is carefully picked, each product is individually wrapped in thick kraft paper to help prevent damage during transit. Your order is then packed with dry ice inside one of our insulated shipping containers. 

Customers can choose between: 

our recyclable insulated shipping cooler, or  

our signature Nature Cooler™ — a 100% biodegradable insulated shipping container available as an upgrade at checkout.  

 

Before your order leaves our facility, it is stored in our holding freezer until carrier pickup. This is an important detail because it cools the entire package down before transit, extending frozen holding power by up to 12 additional hours during shipping.
 

Every shipment includes enough dry ice to keep the package frozen for at least an additional 24 hours beyond the expected delivery window as added protection against carrier delays. 

Once your package leaves our dock, we actively monitor tracking and delivery progress to help ensure it arrives safely. If we notice delays or concerns during transit, our team may proactively reach out to keep you informed.

Delivery Day.

 

This is where the magic happens. 

Our goal is to deliver a calm, satisfying experience when you open your box. 

Your order should arrive: 

frozen,

organized,  

protected,  

and ready for your freezer.  

The intentionality behind every shipment reflects the level of care we want to provide to you and the responsibility we feel toward the products we ship. 

We do not view these products as commodities. They are animal proteins we have been entrusted to steward responsibly, and that means doing everything we can to ensure a safe, successful delivery. 

If something goes wrong.

 

Even with careful planning and monitoring, shipping carriers occasionally experience delays, damage, or lost packages. 

When that happens, we are still here to help.
 

We offer Route Package Protection in checkout to provide added shipment protection and peace of mind during transit. 

And beyond that, our customer support team genuinely cares about helping make this right.

We are here for you, please reach out.

Real People. Real Care.

We value your business. We value the products we provide. 

And we believe serving customers well includes the delivery experience, not just the products themselves. 

Shipping is not an afterthought for us. It is part of how we care for the food, the animals entrusted to us, and the families we serve. 

 

Watch our shipping process in action.

 

Want to see how it all works? 

Watch the video for a behind-the-scenes look at how Northstar Bison carefully packs and ships frozen orders across the country. 

 

Additional shipping information.

 

For holiday shipping schedules, transit timing, delivery zones, more information on Route, and additional shipping policies, continue scrolling below. 

About Route Shipping Protection:

Route Shipping Protection offers added peace of mind by protecting your order against loss, damage, or theft during transit. If something happens to your package, adding Route to your order makes the resolution process simple with fast replacements or refunds.

While Route is optional, orders placed without shipping protection are shipped at the customer’s risk. Northstar Bison is not responsible for packages that are delayed, lost, or damaged once they are in the carrier’s possession.

 

Route is very affordable. But not everyone needs or wants Route. Our decision to offer Route is out of a desire to put the decision in your hands. Some folks need it, others don't. Without Route, we end up footing the bill on losses which, in the end, costs everyone, which we're trying to protect against.

Delivery Tips

 Over the years we've found a few tricks that can improve the success of your deliveries. Take a gander at the few simple pointers of what to expect and how best to prepare for the arrival of your precious package so you can have your very own fist-pump moment. :)

 

When is it Coming?

Know what day your package is set to arrive. Click the "Track Your Package" button in your shipping confirmation and set a reminder in your phone or on your calendar as to what day your package will arrive.
We all have lots going on and it's easy to forget!

 

P.S. If you haven't signed up for UPS My Choice  you may want to!
See status updates, change package pick up locations, and more.

 

What if I'm not home?! --> Just leave a note.

If you plan to be gone during the day (or even if you'll be home it's still not a bad idea) when your package is likely to arrive, it's always a great idea to leave your delivery person a nice note stating where they can leave the package. In the shade and out of plain view of the street is a perfect place.

 

What do I do with my box?

Recycle or compost! The cardboard and styrofoam is 100% recyclable, our Nature Cooler insulation panels are 100% biodegradable. Or you can store the box and use it again for a day at the lake, keeping groceries cold on your way home, or any other use you may have for a cooler.

 

Thawing?

Though we try to avoid any thawing at all costs, things happen. If your box arrives for whatever reason with thawing, don't throw it away. Take a picture, put everything away in the fridge/freezer, and then reach out. Grass fed meats are much different than ordinary meats. They don't as readily host e-coli or salmonella, the main concerns with thawing and refreezing meat. If some of the meat is thawed but still cold there is a strong possibility it isn't trash. But shoot us a call or an email, we want to make sure we know about the situation and also want to make sure you're well taken care of.

 

Thawing for Meal Prep Tips

Now, to intentionally thaw a package of meat, we recommend putting it on a plate or bowl in the refrigerator on the bottom shelf. The refrigerator is the best place to thaw meat slowly while keeping bacterial activity very low. Thawing on a plate or bowl will contain any potential leaking.... the meat packaging can sometimes have a microscopic pin hole somewhere in the plastic that occurred during shipping or through handling that you cannot find with your eyes but will become obvious once the package thaws. This is not typical but is a good precaution to avoid having to clean up your fridge.

SHOP BISON STEW, STEAK KABOBS, & FAJITA MEAT
PREMIUM BISON. PREPPED FOR WHAT’S COOKING.

Great meals start with exceptional meat, and sometimes, a little less prep work.

Our Bison Stew, Steak Kebabs & Fajita Meat collection makes it easy to bring premium, 100% grass-fed and finished bison into some of your favorite meals. Thoughtfully cut and ready for the kitchen, these versatile options help you spend less time prepping and more time creating something worth gathering around.

Slow-simmer bison into a hearty stew. Fire up the grill for tender steak kebabs. Sear fajita meat with peppers and onions for a quick, flavorful dinner. However you prepare it, you’re starting with naturally lean, nutrient-dense bison raised to the Northstar standard.

At Northstar Bison, our animals are raised on pasture, 100% grass-fed and finished, and cared for with respect for their natural design. That commitment gives you exceptional meat you can feel good about serving, whether dinner has been simmering all afternoon or comes together on a busy weeknight.

Simple to prepare. Endlessly versatile. Made for meals that bring people together.

100% grass-fed and finished. Ready for your favorite recipes. Wildly better from the start.
